description: At session start, mention dreaming proposals waiting for review in this project (one line, nothing if none).

hooks.command: IN=$(cat); printf '%s' "$IN" | python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dreamctl.py" pending 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dreamctl.py" pending 2>/dev/null || true
